positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Research Intern
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Recreated AI data collection pipeline described in a research paper (VFHQ: A High-Quality Dataset and Benchmark for Video Face Super-Resolution), leveraging advanced inference models to scrape YouTube for 4K facial video data

- Integrated models for bounding box detection (RetinaFace), object tracking using SORT algorithm, identity verification (L2 difference of facial embeddings from ArcFace), and image quality assessment (HyperIQA) + landmark motion (FaceAlignment)

- Reduced need for human filtering by 50% by adding additional models to filter video transitions (TransNetV2), face occlusion (IOU between objects identified by YOLOv7), and extreme face angles (calculated from landmark coordinates)

- Achieved 216% speedup using multiprocessing, batching, and image quality reduction before scaling pipeline with additional GPUs and CPUs

- Generated 20+ hours of individual 4K video clips for training data

- Evaluated existing models' performance using video quality metrics (PSNR, SSIM, FID) to guide model fine-tuning

- Identified underrepresented demographics in existing training data by generating race/gender distributions of 100+ hours of video data and adjusted data collection pipeline queries to target these demographics
positions.insights: Skills: Ffmpeg · OpenCV · Keras · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · CUDA · PyTorch · TensorFlow

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:

• Implemented user account management solutions utilizing MongoDB for enhanced data handling
• Created wireframes for a rules engine interface through regular client meetings, ensuring alignment with client needs
• Built the rules engine user interface using JavaScript, NodeJS, and React, enabling custom rule creation for supply chain orders
